knowledge.text: 計算鄰星混光對凌日深度的稀釋，規劃質心與孔徑比較驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate transit-depth dilution from a neighbouring star and plan centroid/aperture checks.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 若凌日僅在目標星，δ觀測=δ真 Ft/(Ft+Fc)；需先辨認發生凌日的光源。
knowledge.textEn: If only the target transits,δ_obs=δ_true Ft/(Ft+Fc); identify the actual eclipsed source before applying correction.

quiz.question: 「孔徑中的兩顆星」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Two stars in an aperture: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付孔徑表、差分圖與稀釋不確定度，不僅報一個行星半徑。
若改孔徑後深度加深，可能減少混光，也可能納入另一變星；須查看差分影像。
optionsEn: δ_true=0.008×(800+200)/800=0.01; uncorrected depth is 20% low.
Deliver aperture data,difference images and dilution uncertainty,not only one planet radius.
Deeper dips after changing aperture may mean less dilution or inclusion of another variable; inspect difference images.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若改孔徑後深度加深，可能減少混光，也可能納入另一變星；須查看差分影像。 與本階段判準一起判讀：總通量是兩者相加，凌日只扣其中一顆。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Deeper dips after changing aperture may mean less dilution or inclusion of another variable; inspect difference images. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Total flux adds both stars,while the transit removes light from one.

steps.title: 孔徑中的兩顆星 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Two stars in an aperture · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「孔徑中的兩顆星」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Two stars in an aperture and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若改孔徑後深度加深，可能減少混光，也可能納入另一變星；須查看差分影像。
對照「孔徑中的兩顆星」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。只有凌日來源被定位且通量比例可驗證，才用混光修正半徑估計。
本階段必須重驗：總通量是兩者相加，凌日只扣其中一顆。
steps.instructionEn:
Deeper dips after changing aperture may mean less dilution or inclusion of another variable; inspect difference images.
Against the nominal Two stars in an aperture result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Use dilution-corrected radius estimates only after localizing the event and verifying flux ratios.
Reverify this criterion: Total flux adds both stars,while the transit removes light from one.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若改孔徑後深度加深，可能減少混光，也可能納入另一變星；須查看差分影像。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Deeper dips after changing aperture may mean less dilution or inclusion of another variable; inspect difference images.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 總通量是兩者相加，凌日只扣其中一顆。
steps.checkEn: Total flux adds both stars,while the transit removes light from one.

quiz.questionEn: Two stars in an aperture: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 若凌日僅在目標星，δ觀測=δ真 Ft/(Ft+Fc)；需先辨認發生凌日的光源。
只有凌日來源被定位且通量比例可驗證，才用混光修正半徑估計。
TESS 以可見光巡天研究系外行星及其他亮度變化天體。

Use dilution-corrected radius estimates only after localizing the event and verifying flux ratios.
TESS surveys visible-light variability including transiting exoplanets.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。只有凌日來源被定位且通量比例可驗證，才用混光修正半徑估計。 與本階段判準一起判讀：總通量是兩者相加，凌日只扣其中一顆。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Use dilution-corrected radius estimates only after localizing the event and verifying flux ratios. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Total flux adds both stars,while the transit removes light from one.

steps.title: 孔徑中的兩顆星 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Two stars in an aperture · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「孔徑中的兩顆星」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Two stars in an aperture and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付孔徑表、差分圖與稀釋不確定度，不僅報一個行星半徑。
在交接件中加入「孔徑中的兩顆星」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：總通量是兩者相加，凌日只扣其中一顆。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：計算鄰星混光對凌日深度的稀釋，規劃質心與孔徑比較驗證。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver aperture data,difference images and dilution uncertainty,not only one planet radius.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Two stars in an aperture: Total flux adds both stars,while the transit removes light from one.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Calculate transit-depth dilution from a neighbouring star and plan centroid/aperture checks. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。總通量是兩者相加，凌日只扣其中一顆。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Total flux adds both stars,while the transit removes light from one.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 總通量是兩者相加，凌日只扣其中一顆。
steps.checkEn: Total flux adds both stars,while the transit removes light from one.
